name: Mistwood Homestay
headline: A family home in the coffee hills, where the mist comes up the valley every morning.
subline: Four rooms on a working coffee and pepper estate, run by the same family for three generations. Home-cooked Kodava meals, long walks through the plantation, and evenings by the fire.
highlights: Wake up above the clouds on a 40-acre coffee estate
Kodava home cooking, three meals a day, from the family kitchen
Guided plantation walks and a stream you can swim in

reviews.text: We came for two nights and stayed five. The food alone is worth the drive, and waking up to the valley full of mist is something we'll never forget.
reviews.name: Ananya Rao

reviews.text: Feels like staying with family, not at a hotel. Uncle took us around the estate and explained how the coffee is grown. Spotless rooms and the warmest hosts.
reviews.name: Rohit Menon

reviews.text: Peaceful, green and completely away from the noise. The bonfire under the stars was the highlight of our trip to Coorg.
reviews.name: Sara Thomas

name: Casa Areia
headline: A whitewashed Portuguese villa, two minutes' walk from a quiet stretch of sand.
subline: Three bedrooms around a shaded courtyard and a small pool, with mango trees, slow mornings and the sound of the sea at night. Book a room, or take the whole house.
highlights: Two minutes on foot to one of Goa's quietest beaches
Restored 1920s Portuguese house with a private courtyard pool
Goan breakfast cooked fresh every morning by our housekeeper

rooms.name: The Courtyard Room
rooms.note: King bed, opens straight onto the pool and the mango tree.

rooms.name: The Terracotta Suite
rooms.note: Our largest room, with a daybed, a reading corner and a private balcony.

rooms.name: The Garden Room
rooms.note: Quiet and cool, with a four-poster bed and an outdoor shower.

reviews.text: The most beautiful house we've stayed in anywhere in Goa. Quiet, spotless, and the beach is right there. Breakfast by the pool every morning was a dream.
reviews.name: Meera Kapoor

reviews.text: Perfect for our family of five. The hosts helped with everything from scooters to restaurant tips. We're already planning to come back next winter.
reviews.name: Daniel Fernandes

reviews.text: Old Goa charm with every comfort you need. You hear the waves at night and wake up to birds in the garden. Truly a hidden gem.
reviews.name: Priya Nair

name: Green Haven Homestay

Home-cooked Kerala breakfast, served every morning at 8:00 am
Family-run hospitality, 10 minutes from Munnar town

name: The Sari Bungalows
headline: A quiet tropical-garden base for Pemuteran, snorkelling and Menjangan trips.
subline: The Sari Bungalows is a small, relaxed guesthouse in Pemuteran, set in a lush tropical garden just off North Bali’s main road. Guests consistently praise the clean, comfortable rooms, friendly staff, refreshing pool and tasty included breakfast. Its quiet location is close to Pemuteran Beach, restaurants, snorkelling trips and the diving area around Menjangan Island.
highlights: Lush tropical garden and peaceful location
Clean, comfortable rooms and a refreshing pool
Breakfast included and close to Pemuteran Beach

reviews.name: Hannah
reviews.text: INCREDIBLE Homestay with wonderful hosts! The room was incredible, the grounds beautiful and spacious, it included breakfast and had a lovely pool. For the price it was absolutely unreal. Would definitely come back to this place! I went by myself but would be really cute for a couple! Terima Kasih!

reviews.name: Nico
reviews.text: Absolutely perfect! The room are clean and super comfy, and the bathroom is so cool. The staff is very kind and friendly, the swimming pool is great and the breakfast is consistent and tasty. Ideally placed in a quiet area, close to the beach and restaurants. I strongly recommend!

reviews.name: J. W.
reviews.text:
We definitely recommend this nice, clean and authentic place. Made, the owner, is super nice, helped us with the further option to travel and was so heartwarming. Also the staff was so kind and always had a smile. The pool, the room and the common places were super clean. The cleanest one we had on our travel!!!! They breakfast is also very nice and you have a big selection.
Thank you for everything!

name: Villa Baba Sunset Beach Inn
map_query: Villa Baba Sunset Beach Inn, Temukus, Bali
headline: Your little beachfront escape in North Bali.
subline: Wake up to the sound of the ocean and experience the laid-back charm of North Bali at Villa Baba Sunset Beach Inn. Set along the coastline of Temukus, near Lovina, this intimate beachfront stay offers a relaxed setting for couples, families and travellers looking to slow down. Spend peaceful moments by the pool, stroll along the shore, or take in the colours of a North Bali sunset right by the sea.
highlights: Stay right by the sea, with direct access to the coastline and ocean views
Relax at your own pace by the pool and in the garden
Discover North Bali: Lovina, dolphin-watching, waterfalls and hot springs

reviews.name: Raquelle
reviews.text: Stopped in by chance while driving thru Lovina. Putu is the manager of this great little spot right on the water. I've only been here a few hours and feel like family already.

reviews.name: Guest
reviews.text: Beautiful location, amazing staff and awesome villa ! Definitely I would recommend it as a must visit place in Lovina beach!

reviews.name: Yulinda
reviews.text: Very clean, with beautiful ocean and sunset views, and a pier that leads directly to the beach. The rooms are spacious enough for a family. The swimming pool is clean and well-maintained. Highly recommended, especially for family vacations.

moments.text: Head out on a dolphin-watching trip along the Lovina coast.

local.heading: Around *Lovina*
local.note: Wake up early for Lovina's famous dolphin trips, bring swimwear and snorkelling gear for the coastline, try Banjar Hot Springs, and leave time in the evening for the sunset on the beach. Travel times are approximate.
